asr.full_text: Hello everyone, welcome to the crypto lab channel. Please watch this video to the end and if you like it, then like it, subscribe to the channel and put a bell so as not to miss the next video. Today we will talk about Dogecoin to analyze the latest news, and also see how it manifests itself and what will happen to it in the future. Write in the comments your opinion about Dogecoin and what will happen to its price in the near future. Unilever men's fragrance brand Axe has introduced a limited-edition Dogecan deodorant. The name is a reference to the Dogecoin meme cryptocurrency. Axe will ship new products free of charge to customers who register on the site. The campaign kicks off on July 20. Dogecan is described as a 48-hour crypto scent with raw musk. Gift sets have already been received by Dogecoin supporters, including its creator Billy Marcus. The cover letter says, We're going to the moon – here you will find everything you need to do this." In April, Axe promised to release a special series if Dogecoin hit $1. At that time, the rate exceeded 40 cents, and the asset was in the top five of the market with a capitalization of $50 billion. Quotes never reached a significant level- at the time of writing, DogeCoin is trading at $0.20. Previously renowned tech analyst and head of Factor LLC, Peter Brandt, saw the risks of a double head and shoulders pattern on the doge chart, which indicates an extremely bearish scenario for the cryptocurrency. As a reminder, in June, Minneapolis Federal Reserve president Neel Kashkari called the meme cryptocurrency the ponzi scheme. Prior to this, billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller criticized Dogecoin and compared interest in it with the hype around non-fungible tokens. So, Dogecoin price analysis, Is doge retesting the twenty dollars mark and preparing for another fall overnight the cryptocurrency market has been trading with mixed results over the past 24 hours as the market has taken over a bearish momentum overnight market leader bitcoin fell three percent and ethereum rose 0.3 doge has traded in a range of 0.195 dollars to 0.203 dollars indicating moderate volatility over the past 24 hours trading volume increased 12.39 to 1 billion while the total market capitalization is around 25.7 billion dollars making the cryptocurrency rank 8 overall in the 4 hours chart we see the dogecoin price starting to decline again as the bears hope to reach the major support level of $0.165 again. Dogecoin's price action has become increasingly bearish over the past few days as a clear lower high near $1 was set on August 0.215. This price change was the result of a rise of more than 45 percent from the end of july with strong resistance found around the 0.23 mark dollar from the 23 cents mark doge quickly rolled back and began to consolidate above the 20 cents mark after another attempt to move up the doge rate was quickly reversed and on august 0.2 the price overcame the support of three dollars yesterday dogecoin made another attempt to climb and it was quickly resisted by the support at $0.20, which turned into resistance. Dogecoin price analysis is bearish for the next 24 hours as further gains cannot be achieved overnight and the market momentum turns bearish again. As such, we expect Doge to advance to further lows today and hit the major support level of $0.165 dollars later this week a breakout of the 17 cents level will turn the critical support level into a resistance barrier that will hinder growth thus a potential spike in selling pressure that pushed Doge below 17 cents would invalidate the bullish outlook and potentially trigger a crash to 0.157 dollars Dogecoin price has faced a difficult time, breaking the critical ceiling that slowed its growth. Compared to other altcoins, DOJ is struggling, successfully breaking this 21 cents barrier will pave the way for retesting the massive supply barrier that extends from 0.255 dollars to 29 cents. For now, it is better to observe the price from the outside or if you are planning to invest in doge you should check all the latest information about it yourself do you invest in dogecoin and what do you think will happen to this cryptocurrency in a week or a month write your opinion about it in the comments
